sessions.prompt:
Add parse_weight(s) to parcels.py: a weight in kilograms such as "1.5kg" becomes int grams (1500). Add tests.

The plan for parse_weight has one more step: it also accepts grams ("750g" becomes 750) and pounds ("2lb" becomes 908; 1 lb is 454 g). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a parcel weighs more than 0 and at most 30 kg: any function given a parcel weight outside that range raises ValueError.

Design decision for this project: volumetric weight uses 5000 cm³ per kg: a box of l x w x h cm weighs l*w*h/5000 kg.

given.handoff: Session 1 added parse_weight(s) with tests. Its last step is left for later: accept grams and pounds (1 lb is 454 g).
decisions: A parcel weighs more than 0 and at most 30 kg; outside that range raises ValueError in any function.
Volumetric weight uses 5000 cm³ per kg.

sessions.prompt:

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): country codes ignore case and must be exactly two letters; any function given another code raises ValueError.

Design decision for this project: shipping costs 200 cents for each started kilogram of the charged weight, on top of the zone's base price.

Design decision for this project: the weight line of a label has the form Weight: 1500 g.
